Getter correctly checks for 'vlcsnap-*.png' files on /home/user/Desktop using ls glob — VLC saves snapshots with this naming convention, so this accurately verifies that a snapshot was taken after the path was changed.

Both instruction sub-goals (change snapshot directory to Desktop, take a snapshot) are covered by the two separate boolean checks in the getter.
